n: Ezra Thayre and Northrop Sweet are called to listen to the Lord, whose word pierces soul and spirit and discerns the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

f.w: a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart

n: They are to preach loudly to a “crooked and perverse generation.”
It is the “eleventh hour” — the last call for workers in the vineyard, as in Jesus’ parable of laborers hired late in the day.
The vineyard is corrupted; only a few do good, and many err because of priestcraft — preaching for gain or praise.

f.g: preaching for money or popularity rather than for God’s glory.

n: The Lord has brought this Church out of the wilderness — out of obscurity.

f.w: called forth out of the wilderness

n: He will gather his elect from the four corners of the earth — all who believe and listen.

f.w: the four quarters of the earth

n: The field is ready; reap with all your might, mind, and strength.
“Open your mouths and they shall be filled” — a beloved missionary promise. They will be like Nephi, who journeyed in faith.

f.w: Open your mouths and they shall be filled

n: Speak boldly without holding back, and you will gather a full harvest, for the Lord is with you.
Their message, echoing John the Baptist: repent, prepare the Lord’s way, make his paths straight, for the kingdom is near.

f.w: prepare ye the way of the Lord, and make his paths straight

n: Repent and be baptized by water for forgiveness; then comes the baptism of fire and the Holy Ghost.

f.w: repent and be baptized, every one of you
the baptism of fire and of the Holy Ghost

n: This is Christ’s gospel; without faith in him, no one can be saved.
On this rock — the gospel — Christ builds his Church, and those who continue on it will not be overcome by hell.

f.w: upon this rock I will build my church

n: Remember and keep the Church’s articles and covenants (D&C 20).
Those with faith should be confirmed by the laying on of hands to receive the Holy Ghost.

f.w: by the laying on of the hands

n: The Book of Mormon and the Bible are given for their instruction, and the Spirit gives life to all things.
Be faithful and prayerful, with lamps trimmed and oil ready for the Bridegroom’s coming — from the parable of the ten virgins.

f.w: having your lamps trimmed and burning

n: Christ says he is coming quickly — soon, and suddenly.
